slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet allocated exclusively for training produce in a single year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-year pilot training capacity of one training jet, which directly matches the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when the training program starts or how long training lasts. Turn 6 asks about production pool independence by year, not the training duration/start timeline.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training effectively occurs in Year 1 and Year 2, and pilots accumulate over the two years according to 5*x1 + 5*x2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration; it assumed the two-year training timeline and accumulation pattern in its READY_TO_MODEL summary and final model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 slot H1 was resolved, but the P1 slot H3 about training start/duration was never asked and remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the critical training-capacity fact, but failed to clarify the training start/duration and never addressed the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, stopping with P1 slot H3 unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
